Subject: 20% off Stormline jackets — offer ends Sunday
Preview: 420g shell, 20k/20k rated. Built for sustained wet weather. 20% off through Sunday.
Body: If you're heading out this season and rain is in the forecast, here's something worth knowing.

The Northbay Stormline Shell Jacket (NB-JKT-07) is a 3-layer laminate shell rated at 20,000mm waterproofing and 20,000 g/m² breathability. It weighs 420g. That rating holds up across sustained wet weather — the kind of all-day drizzle and intermittent downpours that separate functional kit from frustrating kit.

It's a shell. It's not insulated, and it's not built for alpine climbing or extreme cold on its own. Pair it with a mid-layer you already trust.

Through Sunday, all Stormline jackets are 20% off. No code needed — discount applied at checkout.
